headword: {優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}

definitions.explanation: Unable to make decisions promptly or firmly. Describes a person who hesitates and wavers when choices need to be made.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}だ。
メニューを{決|き}めるのに{三十分|さんじゅっぷん}もかかるなんて、{優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}にも{程|ほど}がある。
examples.english: Taking thirty minutes to decide on the menu is being indecisive to an extreme.

examples.japanese: {優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}な{性格|せいかく}を{直|なお}したくて、{即断即決|そくだんそっけつ}を{心|こころ}がけている。
examples.english: I want to fix my indecisive personality, so I try to make quick decisions.

notes:
USAGE:
A four-character compound ({四字熟語|よじじゅくご}) commonly used in everyday conversation, not just formal writing. Almost always negative in nuance.

ETYMOLOGY:
{優柔|ゆうじゅう} (soft, gentle) + {不断|ふだん} (without cutting/deciding). Literally "soft and unable to cut" — unable to make a clean decision.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}な{性格|せいかく} (indecisive personality)
- {優柔不断|ゆうじゅうふだん}な{人|ひと} (an indecisive person)
